queries.query: CVPR 2026 accepted papers 3D reconstruction streaming video
searched_locations: Official CVPR 2026 virtual papers site and official/proceedings pages surfaced by web search
Official CVPR 2026 virtual papers site and official/proceedings pages surfaced by web search

results.title: STream3R: Scalable Sequential 3D Reconstruction with Causal Transformer
results.abstract_or_snippet: Presents a streaming framework for 3D reconstruction that reformulates pointmap prediction as a decoder-only Transformer problem and processes image sequences with causal attention for online 3D perception.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; directly matches streaming/video, 3D reconstruction, and pointmap prediction.

results.title: StreamSplat: Towards Online Dynamic 3D Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Video Streams
results.abstract_or_snippet: Introduces a feed-forward framework that transforms uncalibrated video streams of arbitrary length into dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting representations online, under latency and memory constraints.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; directly matches online video-stream 3D reconstruction.

results.title: $\pi^3$: Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning
results.abstract_or_snippet: A feed-forward visual geometry model that predicts camera poses and local point maps without a fixed reference view, with evaluations including monocular/video depth estimation and dense point map reconstruction.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; matches the point-map and video geometry/reconstruction aspects of the query.

results.title: CogniMap3D: Cognitive 3D Mapping and Rapid Retrieval
results.abstract_or_snippet: Presents a dynamic 3D scene understanding and reconstruction framework that maintains persistent memory for static scenes, handles image streams, and evaluates video depth estimation, camera pose reconstruction, and 3D mapping.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to streaming/image-stream 3D mapping and reconstruction.

results.title: FastAvatar: Towards Unified and Fast 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Large Gaussian Reconstruction Transformers
results.abstract_or_snippet: Proposes a feed-forward 3D avatar reconstruction framework that can use single images, multi-view observations, or monocular video, with incremental reconstruction as more observations are available.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; partially matches video-based incremental 3D reconstruction, though focused on avatars rather than general scene point maps.

results.title: Vid-LLM: A Compact Video-based 3D Multimodal LLM with Reconstruction-Reasoning Synergy
results.abstract_or_snippet: A video-based 3D multimodal LLM that uses geometric priors and reconstruction outputs to support 3D question answering, dense captioning, and visual grounding.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 oral in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to video-based 3D reconstruction outputs, but not primarily an online point-map reconstruction method.

results.title: Lyra: Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction via Video Diffusion Model Self-Distillation
results.abstract_or_snippet: Distills 3D knowledge from video diffusion models into explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting representations and extends to dynamic 3D scene generation from monocular input video.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to video-based 3D scene reconstruction/generation but not specifically online streaming point-map reconstruction.

results.title: Text-to-3D by Stitching a Multi-view Reconstruction Network to a Video Generator
results.abstract_or_snippet: Combines a text-to-video generator with a feed-forward 3D reconstruction system and reports high-quality text-to-pointmap generation with suitable 3D base models.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 oral in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to video-generator-based 3D/pointmap generation, but not an online video-stream reconstruction method.

results.title: Hyden: A Hybrid Dual-Path Encoder for Monocular Geometry of High-resolution Images
results.abstract_or_snippet: A high-resolution monocular geometry encoder for depth, point map, and surface normal estimation with low inference latency.
results.scope_match_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 poster in the official OpenReview venue collection; matches point-map geometry and efficient inference, but is image-focused rather than streaming video reconstruction.

coverage_gaps.gap: The official CVPR 2026 papers page was reachable but its paper list requires JavaScript and did not expose searchable paper records in the retrieved text. CVF Open Access searches for CVPR 2026 did not return in-scope official proceedings matches for the query.
Scoped OpenReview searches for ICML 2026 with online/streaming/video/3D reconstruction/point-map terms returned no candidate results.

Several plausible CVPR 2026 candidates appeared only on author, project, institutional, or GitHub pages. They were not used as in-scope evidence because the plan allows author-hosted PDFs only after matching papers to accepted venue collections.
